rule: Each ruling names the EXACT first-party sentences (verbatim substrings of the stored page's visible text) that operate on one census identity. The build re-verifies every quote against the stored page bytes and runs the SHARED readers (prose_facts / prose_fee_ladder) on the quotes. A reader result is overruled only toward a hold, never toward a publication: negation the shared reader cannot see ('not pet-friendly', 'do not allow pets') forces EVIDENCE_HOLD. Headings, amenity chips and marketing adjectives are never operative on their own.
